conventions.note: Chosen to be unlike any convention the code might special-case. Phase 4 must infer this structure and have the user confirm it. Nothing here may be hardcoded.

declared_but_never_enacted.why: Given a whole section in two bible documents and marked load-bearing, yet the pair share no scene in any drafted transmission. The gap an author most wants surfaced.

enacted_but_never_declared.why: The most page time of any pair in the corpus, and the bible does not mention the relationship at all. Sister Yeong has no profile.

provenance_disagreements.note: A pipeline that merges the two provenance classes into a single graph loses both findings. Keeping them distinct is Invariant 5.

kind_control.why: It issues decisions and never speaks. A pipeline that renders it as a person, or drops it for having no dialogue, has lost something deliberate.

alias_control.why: 'M.' appears only in the bible frontmatter and never in narrative. Aliases declared in reference material must still resolve when the narrative uses them.

mixed_stages.note: t03 is an outline, not prose. Extraction must either handle it or exclude it deliberately — silently treating an outline as narrative inflates relations that were only ever planned.
